description: Sent to students studying a subject when a teacher publishes a reading list for it, pointing them at the required and recommended titles. Triggered when a reading list is shared.
subject: Reading list: {{list_title}} ({{subject}})
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

A reading list has been shared for {{subject}}:

  List:        {{list_title}}
  Required:    {{required_count}} title(s)
  Recommended: {{recommended_count}} title(s)

Open the library catalogue to find these titles, check availability, and reserve anything that's on loan. Start with the required reading.

{{system_name}} Library
